user.title: Aruba Device Tracker
user.description:
Enter the connection details for your Aruba Instant AP.

Make sure REST API is enabled on the IAP.

data_description.host: IP address of your Aruba IAP or Virtual Controller (e.g. 192.168.1.10)
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off unless you have installed a trusted certificate on the IAP. Instant APs ship with a self-signed certificate that cannot be verified.

tracking.title: Tracking & polling
tracking.description:
Configure how devices are tracked and how often the IAP is polled.

All settings can be changed at any time via the integration options.

data_description.track_new_devices: When off, new devices are discovered but their entities are disabled until you enable them manually.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to query the IAP for connected clients. Min 10s, max 300s.
data_description.cleanup_enabled: Automatically remove devices not seen for the configured number of days.
data_description.cleanup_days: Number of days without activity before a device entity is removed.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with your Aruba IAP
reauth_confirm.description: The Aruba IAP at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current username and password to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Aruba IAP
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for the Aruba IAP at {host}. The connection is tested before saving, then the integration reloads.

data_description.host: IP address of your Aruba IAP or Virtual Controller (e.g. 192.168.1.10)
data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the stored password.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off unless you have installed a trusted certificate on the IAP. Instant APs ship with a self-signed certificate that cannot be verified.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Aruba IAP. Check the IP address, confirm the device is online, and that REST API is enabled with 'allow-rest-api'.
error.invalid_cert: The AP's certificate could not be verified. Aruba Instant APs ship a self-signed certificate, so either install a certificate your Home Assistant host trusts, or turn off 'Verify SSL certificate'.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the username and password.
error.api_access_denied: Login succeeded but the account cannot run API commands. Ensure the user has full management privileges, not read-only.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Aruba IAP is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings saved. The integration has reloaded with the new connection details.

init.title: Aruba IAP settings
init.description:
Change how devices are tracked and how often the IAP is polled.

To change the IP address, credentials, or certificate verification, use **Reconfigure** on the integration instead.
